entities.summary: Dominique O'Neal Jones is an American professional basketball player who last played for the Changsha Yongsheng of the National Basketball League. A noted scorer in college at the University of South Florida, Jones had the second-highest scoring average in the Big East Conference during the 2009–10 season. Jones has had a long career in the CBA and was named the league's MVP in 2023.
